#SevDefect (evidence)Cause (file:line)Suggested fix (not applied)
D1highMulticolour house cubes hang in mid-air above the horizon at several laps (day-dry orbit f00/f50/f83 upper centre/right; glowing blocks at night). The comment at :52-57 says an earlier version floated; it still does.:75 berm is one flat 62×4.8×70 box; rows climb 5.1 + row×8.2 m (up to ≈ 46 m) at :77, :86 but nothing sits under rows 2-6 (the clusters sit at r = rad+165..220 (:70) while mountains start at rad+220 and +340 (:35), so a cluster stands in front of the peaks, on no slope).Seat each row on terrain/mountain flank (move clusters to the mountain base radius, stack on a stepped berm or sample terrainYAt), or cap rows at 1-2 on the berm. guess for the exact radius fix.
D2medDay sky is a flat saturated blue to the horizon; the brief's near-white haze horizon ("the haze is essential") is absent in every dry-day frame. In fog the ground fades but the sky and mountains stay deep blue/crisp.Def palette is correct (:28-39, horizon [.86,.86,.82], fogDensity 0.0034); the rendered result is engine-side (sky dome / fog application, js/lighting). guess: sky ignores pal.horizon and fog density is too low to wash 300 m+ peaks.Confirm with __apex.lightState() on this circuit; if palette is read, raise fogDensity / add horizon gradient in the sky shader (engine task, not circuit data).
D3medMountains are 28 identical sharp pyramids with tan snow-cap tops; the brief asks for smooth forested granite domes with "low roughness". At night the pale caps read as lit wedges.:26-40: hMin 150-280 vs wMin 190-370, seg 8, snowline:2 (:29,:31) which tints the summit tan/white.Raise width/height ratio, drop snowline (or set above peak height), add per-peak seed variation; flat-top dome via ridge(). guess on mountain() option semantics (read docs/SCENERY-API.md first).
D4medOrbit at lap 0.00 sits on the pit-grandstand roof (a grey slab fills the lower-left); the trackside f00 frame is a blank wall (pit bleacher). Both read as camera inside geometry.Pit grandstand 150×20 m, roof 17 m, 13 m from the centreline on the right (:324-352); bleacher 82 m long left (:370-391). Camera-clearance in shot.mjs did not step round them. Mostly a capture artefact but the 13 m setback + 5.6 m deck leaves ≈ 5 m of apron to the road edge.Re-shoot f00 with --az flipped or --side -1; if the apron is judged too tight, widen the anchor (:324) from 13 to ≈ 18 m.
D5medT3 "tube-and-plank stand" renders as a saturated rainbow crowd block on empty grass (orbit f17), far from the pale brief palette.scaffoldStand(0.170,0.190,-1,30) :515 uses the shared generic crowd colours (no palette argument).Pass a pale crowd palette (PALE_CROWD, :21) or replace with a registered modelGroup like the bleacher.

5 · Gallery (%%COUNT%% frames)

Orbit az 45 / el 18 / dist 45 unless stated; laps 0.00, 0.17, 0.33, 0.50, 0.67, 0.83; TLX renderer on SwiftShader (no real GPU) — absolute lighting is not evidence about a player's GPU. Tap an image to enlarge. Sky/horizon here uses the post-lighting-merge atmosphere.

Orbit · day · dry

Dry day baseline. Saturated deep-blue sky with no horizon haze; pyramid mountains with tan caps. Pit frame (f00): camera sits on the pit-grandstand roof slab.

Driver eye · day · dry

Driver-eye. Dark chequer tarmac at the start line; mountains read as sharp pyramids; flags/boards on the left of the pit straight.

Trackside · day · dry

Trackside free-cam. f00 is blocked by the 80 m pit bleacher wall (frame is a blank slab); later stations show flat sandy run-off and low-poly pyramids.

Orbit · day · wet

Wet: road darkens and reflects; sky stays day-blue.

Orbit · day · rain

Rain at day: grey overcast sky, daylight kept (lighting merge works); faint streaks; wet reflections on the pit straight.

Orbit · day · overcast

Overcast: neutral grey light, no shadows.

Orbit · day · fog

Fog at day: ground and mid-distance fade but the sky stays deep blue and mountains stay crisp (fog does not touch sky/horizon).

Orbit · day · storm

Storm at day: dark grey, grass near black, sparse rain; reads as dusk-grey not night (post lighting merge).

Orbit · dusk · dry

Dusk dry: lamps fire; f00/f33 face the sun and show a heavy yellow wash plus purple triangular halos at the top (glare/bloom); deep indigo sky.

Orbit · dusk · rain

Dusk rain.

Orbit · night · dry

Night dry: post lamps fire with warm pools; sky pure black (no stars/moon); mountain tops read as lit pale wedges.

Orbit · night · rain

Night rain: strong wet reflections from lamps, good response; floodlight masts remain unlit.
